When an agent is about to execute a sensitive tool (shell commands, deployments, payments, file deletions), PraisonAIUI pauses the run and asks a human to Approve or Deny — inline inside the chat thread and in the built-in Approvals page (builtin.approvals).

The agent runtime or backend submits an approval request (POST /api/approvals). Connected browsers receive it live over SSE (GET /api/approvals/stream) and show an inline approval card in chat plus an entry on the Approvals page. Pair with aiui.push_notification(..., action={"label": "Review now", "page": "approvals"}) so operators also get an immediate toast + unread badge in the header Notification Bell on the same dashboard. A reviewer clicks Approve (POST /api/approvals/{id}/approve) or Deny (POST /api/approvals/{id}/deny), optionally updating reusable policy rules (PUT /api/approvals/policies). The agent resumes or aborts cleanly, and the decision is recorded in GET /api/approvals/history.

All routes sit behind the server's active auth middleware (R8). Method & Path Purpose GET /api/approvals List all approvals (or GET /api/approvals/pending for open items) POST /api/approvals Create a new approval request POST /api/approvals/{approval_id}/approve Approve a pending request POST /api/approvals/{approval_id}/deny Deny a pending request GET /api/approvals/history Audit log of past decisions GET / PUT /api/approvals/policies Inspect or update automatic approval policies GET /api/approvals/stream Real-time SSE stream of approval events
